scene: Home entryway. The open door shows a softly moving tree outside; a small cap hangs on the hook at screen-left. Child's yellow hoodie lies folded on the bench at center. Dad stands screen-left near the door; Child stands screen-right. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child shows brief thinking while choosing; both keep a light, prepared-for-outdoors mood; the ending is quietly pleased.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad stands near the open door; Child stands at screen-right with empty hands; the folded hoodie rests on the bench; the cap hangs on the hook.
clips.action: Dad tips his head toward the windy door. Child looks outside, then at his cap on the hook while asking his question; Dad answers with a small tug gesture at an imaginary cap.
clips.end: The hoodie stays folded on the bench; the cap stays on the hook; Child looks at the hoodie.

clips.start: The hoodie stays folded on the bench; the cap stays on the hook; Child looks at the hoodie.
clips.action: Child picks up the folded hoodie with both hands and holds it against his chest while explaining his choice. Dad nods once, approving.
clips.end: Child holds the hoodie against his chest with both hands; Dad stands with empty hands.

clips.start: Child holds the hoodie against his chest with both hands; Dad stands with empty hands.
clips.action: Child pulls the hoodie on over his yellow T-shirt and flips the hood up with both hands, covering his ears. Dad gives a small thumbs-up; Child pats his own hooded ears once and stands tall.
clips.end: Child wears the hoodie with the hood up; the cap stays on the hook; both face the open door, ready to leave.
